full_history.content: I want to upgrade from Pro to Enterprise, but first check my SSO issue.

I’m happyto help. According to our documentation, Single Sign‑On (SSO/SAML) is an Enterprise‑only capability—Pro plans do not include SSO, so there isn’t an SSO configuration to “check” while you’re on the Pro tier [KB-ACC-001][KB-BIL-003].

If you’d like to move to Enterprise (which will give you SSO, custom retention, advanced RBAC, audit logs, etc.), you can upgrade directly from the billing page:

1. Go to **Settings → Billing**.  
2. Under the current subscription, click **‘Upgrade to Enterprise’**.  
3. Fill out the enterprise request form with your estimated seat count.  
4. Our sales operations team will review the request and contact you with a customized contract.  

Once the contract is signed, the upgrade is applied instantly—no redeployment or loss of metrics is required [KB-BIL-003].

Let me know if you’d like to start the upgrade process or if there’s anything else I can clarify.
